Triage: lands in `domain:ui` · `pm:queue` (from `pm:retriage`); rationale: area:ux · Bug · saving a shared view's draft reloads the list and shows the published version again until Publish, so the edit looks lost; measured by the #35702 dev; topic #35547 → p2 (UX rule) · size S.

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Acceptance addition · 2026-11-20T19:55Z · Found by the L2 review of PR #35919 (#35702), by reading the code: the same remount also LOSES work. After a draft save the list remounts on the published view, so a second footer pick (or a second view-settings change) before Publish is built on the published view and the save writes the whole view as the draft, replacing the first change. Example: pick Sum, then Latest, then Publish: only Latest is kept.

Added acceptance line: two successive draft changes to a shared view (two footer picks, or a pick and a view-settings change) both survive into the published version.

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Claim: PM loop · 2026-11-21T06:24Z
Area: b1-DB
Session: `session_01L6bhgW85kwjGaz7HqsmEuv` (area b1-DB, session 2; its os-dev subagent runs under the same session)
Account: `os-sales`
Branch: claude/issue-35932-draft-save-no-remount
Seat: `repo:objectstack#1`
Domain: `domain:ui`
File surface: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/runtime-metadata-persistence.ts`, `objectViewViewCrud.tsx`, possibly `ObjectView.tsx` and `preview/usePendingDrafts.ts`; new tests; a changeset (`@object-ui/app-shell` patch). `MetadataProvider` is left alone where possible.
Container & model: `S/M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus`, `effort: high`
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Premise: first read on main by the area: holds. A shared view's draft save goes through `persistRuntimeMetadata`, which emits the global metadata refresh on every draft save; `MetadataProvider` re-reads, `ObjectView` remounts and reads the published version. The footer calculation row's save uses the same path.
Basis: card #35932, a p2 bug from epic #35547's #35702 work, in the derived p1/p2 bugs the maintainer gave this seat on 2026-11-20 22:31Z.
Scope: a draft save no longer reloads the whole list: the admin keeps seeing the draft and a second change builds on it (both survive to Publish, per the acceptance added by the #35944 review); non-admins still read the published version. Reports also call `persistRuntimeMetadata`; their drafts must not regress. If the deeper read finds the fix needs a change to `MetadataProvider`'s refresh contract, or reads M+, the dev stops and reports before building.
Resume-from: none
Fold-or-serial: serial; no fold. #35955's PR 1 does not touch `objectViewViewCrud.tsx` or `runtime-metadata-persistence.ts` (its claim 7058427316); its PR 2 (shared view Save) uses this path and is ordered after this card. `overlap-check.mjs` runs before the push. The PR carries `Fixes #35932`.

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Claim amendment: PM loop · 2026-11-21T08:43Z (amends 7058585760)
Seat call on the stop rule: the root cause sits one layer deeper than the card. A draft save sends the refresh pulse. While the view list re-reads, `viewsForObjects` counts only ready or error as answered, so the route's object scope reads `settled: false`. AppContent then falls back to the skeleton, ObjectView remounts, and the draft is lost. The seat accepts option A.
File surface, widened:
- `ui/packages/app-shell` `MetadataProvider.tsx`: a type that re-reads in place while it already holds an answer still counts as answered; only a whole-type invalidate or an org clear resets it.
- `objectViewViewCrud.tsx`: a draft's publish or discard clears `viewDraft` on the next view read-back.
- `ObjectView.tsx`: 2 lines.
- Their tests, and an app-shell changeset.
The pulse's meaning for its subscribers does not change.
Conditions:
1. The PR body states the side effect: a publish, an install, or a change in another tab no longer remounts the console route.
2. Before L1, one browser reading of three cases: draft save, no skeleton; publish, no remount; `invalidate('view')`, skeleton as before.
3. `overlap-check.mjs` against #36026 (#35955 PR 1) before the push.
Option B (no pulse on draft save) is not taken. It needs a new ledger-only signal, and it would leave the same remount after publish or install.
